name: A command pushes its list with a detail pane beside it

media.caption: Clipboard History opens as a list with a detail pane beside it.
media.alt: A recording of Slick's search panel in dark mode over a purple gradient wallpaper. Typing “clip” completes to Clipboard History, and Return opens it as a list of four copied items with a detail pane. Moving down the list shows each item in the pane: a note with its character and word count, a link, a color as a purple swatch and a line of code. Typing “hand” filters the list to the link. Recorded from the assembled app running a scripted scenario, with Apple's own apps and their real icons. The copied items are made up for the clip.
